messages:
alex: Quick q — we had a bunch of PD pages last night from batch-ingest (job: batch/ingest-run). Can we route those so infra oncall only gets P1s and ops-team gets P2/P3? Also where is the current PD mapping + runbook/logs?

maria: yeah saw that spike. PD mapping is in the infra repo; dashboards + runbook: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/batch-ingest-overview and https://docs.redwood.ai/runbooks/batch-ingest. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/query?q=service:batch-ingest

sam: For routing, Alertmanager route matching on labels is easiest — set severity:critical => pagerduty service=infra, severity:warning => keep in slack and ops PD. We have PR template. Example route snippet:

```yaml
route:
  receiver: 'slack-ops'
  routes:
    - match:
        service: batch-ingest
        severity: critical
      receiver: 'pd-infra'
    - match:
        service: batch-ingest
        severity: warning
      receiver: 'pd-ops'
```

laura: if we lower the page threshold we should also adjust alert dedupe/window. Right now it's firing for 3/5 failures. Maybe change to 5/10 for transient batch retries.

alex: thanks — where is the repo/PR for changing this? don't want to break oncall paging.

sam: opened draft MR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-config/pull/452 — adds route + changes alert expr to increase failure window. Needs review from infra owners @laura @maria

laura: I'll review today. Also we should add an automated suppression for scheduled batch run window: 02:00-04:00 UTC so we don't page on expected transient failures.

maria: good call. We have ops calendar events, can add silence in Alertmanager via API during window. I can add a small script + k8s cronjob.

oncall-bot: Incident: batch-ingest failure acknowledged by alex. Details: https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026

alex: ok I'll test in staging — can someone share the exact alert name? easier to target.

sam: alert name: BatchIngestJobFailures. expr: increase(batch_job_failures_total[10m]) > 5

maria: Also add a note to runbook about whom to page for P1 vs P2. I can update docs once MR merges.

alex: perfect, I'll follow up after staging test. thanks all :thumbsup:

opsbot: Reminder: if you change PD mapping also add mapping in PD integration console: https://pagerduty.com/services/abcd/edit/routing-keys
